story.title: North Korea Launches Two Ballistic Missiles Amid Nuclear Posturing
story.summary: North Korea fired two short-range ballistic missiles into the sea off its eastern coast. This action occurred shortly after the country reaffirmed its status as a nuclear-armed state and rejected a U.N. resolution calling for an end to its nuclear activities.

timeline_highlights.summary: North Korea has launched more than 10 short-range ballistic missiles into the sea, coinciding with President Trump's announcement of scaled-back military drills with South Korea. The South Korean presidential office condemned the missile launches and ordered military readiness during ongoing joint exercises with the US Reports indicate that the missiles landed outside Japan's exclusive economic zone.

related_stories.summary: The United States has issued a warning regarding the potential escalation of hostilities between Saudi Arabia and the Iran-backed Houthis following a missile attack on Riyadh. This incident marks the first such attack since the resumption of the Yemen conflict, which has seen significant territorial gains by the Houthis and resulted in hundreds of casualties.

related_stories.title: Houthis Claim Missile Attack on Riyadh; Saudi Defense Intercepts
related_stories.summary: Yemen's Houthi rebels claimed responsibility for targeting sensitive sites in Riyadh with ballistic missiles. The Saudi-led coalition reported that the missile was intercepted and destroyed before it could reach its intended target. This incident marks a significant escalation in the ongoing conflict, with air raid alerts issued for Riyadh for the first time since the recent intensification of hostilities.

related_stories.title: Ukraine Launches Major Drone Attack on Moscow During Russian Elections
related_stories.summary: Ukraine has launched over 1,000 drones at Russia, marking the largest drone attack on Moscow to date. The assault coincided with the final day of Russia's parliamentary elections, resulting in at least two fatalities and numerous injuries in the Moscow region. Damage was reported at an oil refinery and a residential building, as local officials confirmed the scale of the attack.
